Purpose of the project
Labeling target
Labeling detail
The purpose is to identify damaged tools in the rail stations that could cause train accidents. This is a bounding box and polygon project.

The yellow part is the pandrol_e-clip.
It looks like a pig tail.
The example above shows normal.

If the pandrol is not in its normal position, it is abnormal.
If the pandrol is around an existing location, such as the image on the left, please label the part itself.
If it’s away from its original position as shown in the image above, label the original position.

The yellow part corresponds to the insulation block.
This is the oval-shaped part.
The example image above shows normal

An abnormal insulation block includes broken or disconnected insulation blocks in different locations, or no insulation block at all.
Please check the examples above and the bounding box range.

Create a B-box on the part itself if it is near the original location, or on the original location if it’s further away from the original location.
Please check the examples above and the bounding box range.
It’s away from the original location
It’s far from the original location
Create a polygon by placing dots along the outline of the long_ear
Select the long_ear that corresponds to the labeled object.
Select the normal / abnormal class based on the status of the long_ear.
Long ears are connected without damage.
Long ears are connected without damage.
Bolts and nuts on the long ear are missing.
Bolts and nuts on the long ear are missing.
Create a bounding box along the outline of the insulator
Select the insulator that corresponds to the labeled object.
Select the normal / abnormal class based on the status of the insulator.
If the insulator is broken, it should be classified as abnormal

Label with bounding box per object.
Annotations are tagged for each end of the object, and multiple annotations can overlap.
If part of the object is invisible or occluded, label the visible part only.
Label the object as far as it’s visible, regardless of its visible range.
